component_diagram:
@startuml
package "代码审查管理平台" {
    [Webhook & Event Ingestion] as Webhook
    [Review/Event Tracking] as EventTracking
    [Rule Management] as RuleMgmt
    [Code Analysis Engine] as AnalysisEngine
        [Analyzer Integrators] as Analyzers
    [Reporting & Feedback] as Reporting
    [Analytics & Statistics] as Analytics

    Webhook --> EventTracking : createEvent(), updateEvent()
    EventTracking --> AnalysisEngine : run_pipeline(), run_task()
    AnalysisEngine --> Analyzers : analyze_security(), etc.
    AnalysisEngine --> RuleMgmt : get_active_rules()
    AnalysisEngine --> Reporting : submit_report()
    Reporting --> Analytics : store_report(), get_trend_data()
}
@enduml

components.name: Webhook & Event Ingestion
components.description: Handles inbound GitLab webhooks and exposes APIs for external/manual event triggering. Parses, verifies, and forwards events to the review lifecycle.

components.name: Review/Event Tracking
components.description: Manages the review event lifecycle, state tracking, and analysis triggers. Exposes query and state transition endpoints.

components.name: Rule Management
components.description: CRUD management and validation for code review rules and prompts. Supplies active rules for analysis pipelines.

components.name: Code Analysis Engine
components.description: Core entrypoint to automated review pipelines. Orchestrates analysis sub-tasks and coordinates results aggregation.

components.name: Analyzer Integrators
components.description: Internal synchronous services/classes that perform concrete code analysis tasks for each specialized domain (security, lint, performance).

components.name: Reporting & Feedback
components.description: Persists and surfaces review results, automates merge request comments, and handles developer feedback ingestion.

components.name: Analytics & Statistics
components.description: Aggregates review/feedback data and exposes analytics endpoints to measure efficiency, trends, and quality metrics.
